name: DIVIDEND — weekly dividend-income finder
what_it_is: A weekly Discord post answering one question: how much capital would each of these names
need to pay $100 a year in dividends. It ranks by yield, flags anything above 8% as a
possible yield trap, and stops. It has never placed an order and has no order code path.
why_there_is_no_genome: It reads dividend yields, not price history. There is no window, no threshold on a moving
average and no signal — the only number in it that resembles a parameter is TRAP_YIELD=0.08,
which is a warning label, not an entry rule. Nothing here can be backtested, and a genome
why_it_cannot_run_in_the_village: context gives closes. Dividend yield is not derivable from closes, and no village data

verdict_already_measured.headline: None. This bot has never been evaluated, because there is nothing to evaluate.
verdict_already_measured.honest_status: It is a recurring information post. It cannot win or lose money and no claim has ever been made for it.

what_the_village_could_still_do: Read it as an example of a bot that correctly refuses to become a strategy. The yield-trap
flag is the only judgement it makes, and it makes it out loud.
